item.title: Implement SPEC.md rate limiter
item.brief:

evidence.before: Ran 3 tests; all 3 errored because TokenBucket.__init__ and KeyedLimiter.__init__ raised NotImplementedError.
evidence.caption: Baseline and final unit-test results.

pr.body: Implemented both dependency-free limiter classes in ratelimit.py. TokenBucket starts full, refills continuously up to capacity, handles backward clock readings without adding refill, and validates acquisition and wait requests. KeyedLimiter uses OrderedDict for LRU tracking, refreshes recency for acquire and wait calls, returns evicted keys as fresh buckets, and enforces the maximum even when max_keys is fractional. Expanded test_ratelimit.py with validation, fractional refill, wait non-consumption, clock reversal, LRU, eviction, and fractional max_keys cases. Final checks: python -m unittest -v (10 passed), python -m compileall -q ratelimit.py test_ratelimit.py (passed), git diff --check (passed). Positive infinity is not rejected because the spec requires values greater than zero and does not explicitly require finiteness.
